concepts.title: OpenDPP Integration API — overview
concepts.description: What the OpenDPP Integration API does, how it is organised, and where to start.

concepts.title: Authentication & tenancy
concepts.description: Authenticate with a tenant API key as a Bearer token; tenant identity is token-bound.

concepts.title: Error model
concepts.description: Error envelopes returned by the API, including the richer ESPR validation-failure shape.

concepts.title: Rate limits
concepts.description: The per-key plan ladder, the per-IP ceiling, and which of the two bites first.

concepts.title: Public access tiers
concepts.description: How one resolution URL serves tiered views via capability tokens.

concepts.title: Sealing & verification

concepts.title: Interop: AAS & UNTP credentials
concepts.description: The standards-conformant projections OpenDPP serves alongside JSON-LD, and where to validate them.

concepts.title: Passports
concepts.description: Create, validate, read, update, seal and manage the lifecycle of Digital Product Passports.

concepts.title: Economic Operators
concepts.description: Register and manage the economic operators (manufacturers/brands, identified by EORI or national registry id) that passports are issued on behalf of.

concepts.title: Battery Units
concepts.description: Per-unit battery serialization (real serials, GS1 AI 21) under a SKU-level passport, plus append-only telemetry events (state of health, charge cycles, status changes) per the EU Battery Regulation.

concepts.title: Facilities
concepts.description: Manufacturing facility master data, identified by GS1 GLN-13 (the Unique Facility Identifier).

concepts.title: Access Grants
concepts.description: Capability tokens implementing tiered legitimate-interest access: issue, approve, deny and revoke dpp_li_… / dpp_auth_… tokens.

concepts.title: Webhooks
concepts.description: Subscribe HTTPS endpoints to passport lifecycle events.

concepts.title: Traceability & Audit
concepts.description: UNTP/EPCIS supply-chain traceability events, lineage queries, and the public seal verifier.

concepts.title: Public Resolution
concepts.description: Unauthenticated, content-negotiated passport resolution: GS1 Digital Link paths, passport and unit pages.

concepts.title: Verifiable Credentials
concepts.description: Issuer trust endpoints that back the UNTP Verifiable Credential representations: the workspace's did:web DID document (public keys only) and its W3C Bitstring Status List for revocation.

concepts.title: Schemas & Vocabulary
concepts.description: Machine-readable contracts: per-category ESPR JSON Schemas, the W3C JSON-LD context, and the curated materials vocabulary.

concepts.title: QR Codes
concepts.description: Export GS1-Digital-Link QR codes (PNG/SVG, 128–2048 px, GS1 quiet zone) for passports and battery units.

concepts.title: eIDAS Keys
concepts.description: Tenant signing-key management.

concepts.title: Account
concepts.description: Identity of the authenticated API key / session: workspace, role, permissions, operator scope, and passport usage against the tier quota — the integration-facing counterpart to the console's profile endpoints.

concepts.title: Service
concepts.description: Service metadata and liveness.

concepts.title: Identity of the authenticated key / session
concepts.description: Returns a compact, integration-focused view of the calling credential: the workspace, the principal's role and resolved permissions, whether the session is an API key, the operator the key is scoped to (null = workspace-wide), and active-p…

concepts.title: Pre-flight: validate battery-unit identifiers without persisting
concepts.description: NON-MUTATING pre-flight for bulk unit import.

concepts.title: List serialised battery units under a passport
concepts.description: Lists all serialised units of the passport, newest first (createdAt DESC).

concepts.title: Serialise individual battery units under a passport (bulk, up to 200)
concepts.description: Creates one or many individual physical battery units (EU Battery Regulation) under a SKU/type-level passport.

concepts.title: Get one battery unit as JSON-LD with its dynamic-data history
concepts.description: Returns the unit as a JSON-LD document (Content-Type: application/ld+json) in the privileged tenant view: currentState (the latest telemetry snapshot) and dynamicData (the 500 most recent events, newest first by recordedAt) are included; t…

concepts.title: Not deletable: a serialised unit is a marketed physical item (always 409)
concepts.description: Always refused with 409.

concepts.title: List a battery unit's telemetry history (newest first, cursor-paginated)
concepts.description: Returns one page of the unit's append-only dynamic-data history ordered by recordedAt DESC, ties broken by id DESC — so paging is deterministic.

concepts.title: Append an immutable telemetry event to a battery unit
concepts.description: Appends one append-only per-unit dynamic-data record (Annex XIII / Art. 77: SoH, cycle count, remaining capacity, temperature, negative events).

concepts.title: Append a batch of telemetry events to a battery unit
concepts.description: Appends up to 500 append-only dynamic-data records to one unit in a single request — the batch venue for backfilling a fleet's telemetry.

concepts.title: List facilities in the tenant workspace
concepts.description: Lists all facilities registered under your tenant workspace, sorted by createdAt descending.

concepts.title: Register a facility (GS1 GLN)
concepts.description: Registers a manufacturing/processing facility as tenant-scoped master data, backing the Unique Facility Identifier (UFI, EN 18219).

concepts.title: Get a single facility
concepts.description: Fetches one facility by id, scoped to your tenant workspace.

concepts.title: Update facility master data (GLN is immutable)
concepts.description: Partially updates a facility's master data.

concepts.title: Delete a facility (passports are unlinked, never deleted)
concepts.description: Removes the facility master-data row.

concepts.title: List access grants and pending access requests
concepts.description: Lists the workspace's access grants — capability-token grants for the Battery Regulation's restricted data tiers (Annex XIII(2)–(4)) — including undecided third-party access requests (status: PENDING, issuerType: REQUEST) submitted via the…

concepts.title: Issue a legitimate-interest access grant directly
concepts.description: Directly issues an ACTIVE legitimate-interest access grant (no pending request involved) and mints its capability token.

concepts.title: Approve a pending access request and mint its token
concepts.description: Approves a PENDING third-party access request (submitted via the hosted request-access page).

concepts.title: Deny a pending access request
concepts.description: Denies a PENDING third-party access request: sets status: DENIED and records decidedAt/decidedBy.

concepts.title: Revoke an access grant (soft revocation)
concepts.description: Soft-revokes a grant: sets status: REVOKED and revokedAt (the row is retained for audit; the public resolvers reject the token from then on).

concepts.title: List economic operators bound to your workspace
concepts.description: Returns the economic operators bound to your workspace, ordered by name.

concepts.title: Register an economic operator and bind it to your workspace
concepts.description: Registers an economic operator (manufacturer, importer, supplier, …) and binds it to your workspace.

concepts.title: Fetch a single bound economic operator
concepts.description: Fetches one economic operator by UUID, scoped to your workspace (404 if no operator with that id exists in your workspace).

concepts.title: Update an operator's name or role (regId is immutable)
concepts.description: Edits an operator bound to your workspace.

concepts.title: Remove an operator (archives if it has passports, else hard-deletes)
concepts.description: Removes an operator, choosing automatically between two outcomes (ESPR passport-persistence compliance — an operator that still has passports must never be hard-deleted):

concepts.title: Restore an archived operator and its archived passports
concepts.description: Un-archives an operator that was soft-deleted by DELETE /api/v1/operators/{id} and brings its archived passports back into the active catalogue: clears the operator's archivedAt, then clears archivedAt and retentionUntil on every archived…

concepts.title: Rotate the tenant's ECDSA signing key pair
concepts.description: Generates a brand-new ECDSA prime256v1 (P-256) key pair for your workspace's advanced-seal signing and rotates it into the encrypted database vault, replacing the previous key.

concepts.title: List passports in your workspace (paginated JSON-LD)
concepts.description: Returns the non-archived passports of every economic operator bound to your workspace, newest first (createdAt DESC).

concepts.title: Create (ingest) a Digital Product Passport
concepts.description: Creates a SKU/type-level Digital Product Passport.

concepts.title: Dry-run ESPR validation of passport metadata (nothing is stored)
concepts.description: Runs the full ESPR category schema validation on a metadata payload without persisting anything — intended for pre-flight checks in integration pipelines.

concepts.title: Permission-free dry-run ESPR metadata validation (strictly rate-limited)
concepts.description: Identical validation semantics to POST /api/v1/passports/validate-only, but requires no specific permission — any valid API key or Console session is accepted, so every plan including the free tier can call it.

concepts.title: Bulk-ingest up to 200 passports with per-row error reporting
concepts.description: Ingests up to 200 passports in one request with partial-success semantics: each row is validated and inserted independently; failed rows are skipped and reported as human-readable strings in errors[].

concepts.title: Ingest a passport from an AAS JSON Environment (seal-verified)
concepts.description: Ingests (creates or updates) a Digital Product Passport from an Industry-4.0 Asset Administration Shell (AAS) JSON Environment — the same format produced by OpenDPP's own AAS export.

concepts.title: Catalog-wide UNTP Verifiable-Credential readiness report
concepts.description: A read-only, tenant-scoped report of which SKUs in your catalog can / can't emit a UNTP Verifiable Credential, and why — so you can fix a whole catalog before relying on VCs, instead of probing passports one at a time.

concepts.title: Fetch a single passport (content-negotiated JSON-LD / AAS / HTML)
concepts.description: Owner-side alias of the public resolver.

concepts.title: Update passport metadata (versioned to history)
concepts.description: Replaces the passport's metadata (the Merkle root and leaf hashes are recomputed) and snapshots the previous metadata into the passport's version history (version = count + 1, changedBy = user email or api-key:<id>, changeReason defaults t…

concepts.title: Permanently delete a DRAFT passport
concepts.description: Hard-deletes a passport only while it is a DRAFT (never published, not publicly resolvable, no retention duty).

concepts.title: Apply the tenant's advanced electronic seal
concepts.description: Signs the passport's Merkle root (SHA-256 tree over the key-sorted top-level metadata entries) with the tenant's vault-held ECDSA P-256 (prime256v1) private key, producing an advanced electronic seal (this is a local cryptographic seal — N…

concepts.title: Transition passport lifecycle status (recall / decommission / reactivate)
concepts.description: Transitions a published passport between live lifecycle states.

concepts.title: Resolve a passport by UUID (JSON-LD / AAS / HTML)
concepts.description: Public, content-negotiated resolution of a Digital Product Passport by its server-assigned UUID.

concepts.title: GS1 Digital Link resolution by GTIN-14 (AI 01)
concepts.description: Unified GS1 Digital Link gateway, GTIN branch.

concepts.title: GS1 Digital Link serialised-item redirect (AI 01 + AI 21)
concepts.description: GS1 Digital Link resolution of an *individual serialised item*.

concepts.title: GS1 Digital Link resolution by GRAI (AI 8003)
concepts.description: Unified GS1 Digital Link gateway, GRAI branch (Global Returnable Asset Identifier).

concepts.title: Resolve an individual serialised battery unit
concepts.description: Public, content-negotiated view of one individual serialised unit (battery) by its unit UUID, including the embedded SKU/type passport (ofModel, masked by the same tier rules as GET /passport/{id}).

concepts.title: Download the platform seal-CA certificate (PEM)
concepts.description: Downloads the platform seal-CA certificate as PEM.

concepts.title: Get the ESPR metadata schema for a product category
concepts.description: Returns the machine-readable ESPR metadata schema for a product category.

concepts.title: Canonical resolvable JSON-LD context for passport & unit documents
concepts.description: Serves the stable, resolvable W3C JSON-LD @context (application/ld+json) that every public passport and battery-unit JSON-LD document references in its @context array — this is the context to dereference when expanding OpenDPP JSON-LD.

concepts.title: W3C JSON-LD context document for passport terms (secondary, fixed term list)
concepts.description: Serves a static W3C JSON-LD @context document (application/ld+json) for the core Digital Product Passport term vocabulary: maps the DPP terms to https://opendpp-node.eu/ns/dpp#… IRIs and createdAt/updatedAt to schema.org dateCreated/dateMo…

concepts.title: Service health check
concepts.description: Liveness probe.

concepts.title: Running API contract version & build identity
concepts.description: Returns the SemVer of the public API contract currently served (apiVersion), plus the source build identity (commit, builtAt).

concepts.title: Compute a GTIN check digit from a company prefix + item reference

concepts.title: Batch-decode many GS1 scans / element strings / Digital Links in one request

concepts.title: Export a print-grade GS1 Digital Link QR code for a passport
concepts.description: Renders the passport's GS1 Digital Link URI (its digitalLinkUri, e.g. https://opendpp-node.eu/01/09501101530003) as a print-grade QR code and returns it as a binary file download.

concepts.title: Bulk-export print-grade QR labels for many passports as a ZIP
concepts.description: Renders a GS1 Digital Link QR code for each of the supplied passports and returns them as a single application/zip download (Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="labels.zip") — the export counterpart to the bulk import.

concepts.title: Export a print-grade QR code for an individual battery unit
concepts.description: Renders the battery unit's GS1 Digital Link URI as a print-grade QR code — the AI-21 path segment carries the unit's real physical serial number (e.g. https://opendpp-node.eu/01/09501101530003/21/BAT-2026-000123).

concepts.title: List the platform-curated material vocabulary
concepts.description: Lists active entries from the platform-global material vocabulary that powers the searchable material/fiber/chemistry pickers in the passport form.

concepts.title: Register a UNTP/EPCIS 2.0 traceability event (VC-shaped)
concepts.description: Registers a supply-chain traceability event carried as a VC-shaped UNTP credential and persists it as an EPCIS 2.0 event row scoped to your tenant.

concepts.title: Capture a native GS1 EPCIS 2.0 document (JSON/JSON-LD)
concepts.description: Captures a native GS1 EPCIS 2.0 document — the standard's own JSON/JSON-LD interchange format — and persists each supported event as an EPCIS event row scoped to your tenant, alongside the VC-shaped POST /api/v1/events path.

concepts.title: Resolve a tenant's did:web DID document
concepts.description: Resolves the issuing workspace's did:web DID document (application/did+json).

concepts.title: List webhook subscriptions (signing secrets stripped)
concepts.description: Lists all webhook subscriptions of the calling workspace.

concepts.title: Register a webhook subscription (signing secret returned once)
concepts.description: Registers an endpoint to receive passport lifecycle webhooks for the calling workspace.

concepts.title: Update a webhook subscription (url / events / active)
concepts.description: Partially updates a subscription: any of url, events, isActive (key present = set, omitted = unchanged).

concepts.title: Delete a webhook subscription
concepts.description: Deletes a webhook subscription, stopping future deliveries to its endpoint.

concepts.title: Rotate a webhook subscription's signing secret
concepts.description: Mints a fresh HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for the subscription and returns it once (the old secret stops validating immediately).

concepts.title: List recent webhook delivery attempts (the outbox)
concepts.description: Returns recent delivery records (the outbox), newest first, for debugging endpoint failures.

concepts.title: Send a signed test event to a subscription
concepts.description: Delivers a single signed sample event to the subscription's URL right now and reports the outcome — use it to confirm your endpoint is reachable and that your signature verification works, without waiting for a real passport event.

concepts.description: Always HTTP 200 once the request is well-formed.

concepts.title: SectorJsonSchemaDocument
concepts.description: A JSON Schema draft-07 document describing the ESPR metadata payload for one product category, served as application/schema+json.

concepts.title: SectorVocabularyContext
concepts.description: Per-category JSON-LD vocabulary context, returned by GET /api/v1/schemas/{category} when Accept contains application/ld+json.

concepts.title: SerializeBatteryUnitsRequest
concepts.description: Either a single unit object, or a batch wrapper {units: [...]}.

concepts.title: SerializeBatteryUnitsResponse
concepts.description: Returned (201) when at least one unit was created.

concepts.title: ServiceVersion
concepts.description: Running API contract version and source build identity, returned by GET /api/v1/version.

concepts.title: TraceEventRegistered
concepts.description: 201 envelope of POST /api/v1/events.

concepts.title: TraceLineageNode
concepts.description: One node of the recursive upstream lineage DAG.

concepts.title: TraceLineageResponse
concepts.description: The upstream pedigree of a traceability event, as a recursive graph of the events it derives from.

concepts.title: UntpEventCredential
concepts.description: A UNTP/EPCIS 2.0 traceability event wrapped as a VC-shaped credential.

concepts.title: UntpEventCredentialSubject
concepts.description: The EPCIS event payload.

concepts.title: UntpEventProof
concepts.description: Credential proof.

concepts.title: UntpVerificationMethod
concepts.description: Embedded verification-method object.

concepts.title: UpdateOperatorRequest
concepts.description: Both fields are optional.

concepts.title: UpdateOperatorResponse
concepts.description: The economic operator as stored after the update.

concepts.title: ValidationErrorItem
concepts.description: One field-level finding from ESPR category validation.

concepts.title: WebhookDeliveriesResponse
concepts.description: Recent webhook delivery attempts for a subscription, newest first, for debugging endpoint failures.

concepts.title: WebhookDeliveryRow
concepts.description: One outbox delivery record (event-level).

concepts.title: WebhookEnvelope
concepts.description: The signed body of every webhook delivery.

concepts.title: WebhookEventFilter
concepts.description: Subscribable event filter values.

concepts.title: WebhookSecretRotateResponse
concepts.description: Confirmation that a subscription's HMAC signing secret was rotated; the new secret is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.

concepts.title: WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest
concepts.description: An endpoint to receive webhook deliveries, and the event types it subscribes to.

concepts.title: WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse
concepts.description: Confirmation that a webhook subscription was created, carrying the stored subscription.

concepts.title: WebhookSubscriptionDeleteResponse
concepts.description: Confirmation that a webhook subscription was deleted.

concepts.title: WebhookSubscriptionListResponse
concepts.description: The calling workspace's webhook subscriptions.

concepts.title: WebhookSubscriptionRow
concepts.description: A webhook subscription row with the HMAC signing secret stripped (it is shown exactly once, in the 201 create response).

concepts.title: WebhookSubscriptionUpdateRequest
concepts.description: All fields optional; include only what you want to change.

concepts.title: WebhookSubscriptionUpdateResponse
concepts.description: The webhook subscription as stored after the update.

concepts.title: WebhookSubscriptionWithSecret
concepts.description: The full subscription row as returned ONLY by the 201 create response — includes the HMAC-SHA256 signing secret.

concepts.title: WebhookTestResult
concepts.description: The outcome of delivering a signed sample event to a subscription's endpoint right now.

concepts.title: WhoamiResponse
concepts.description: The calling credential's identity: its workspace, the resolved auth principal and permissions, and active-passport usage against the plan quota.

concepts.description: Passport created or first published

concepts.title: passport.recalled
concepts.description: Passport recalled

concepts.title: passport.sealed
concepts.description: Passport sealed with an advanced electronic seal

concepts.title: passport.status_updated
concepts.description: Passport status changed (decommission or reactivation)

concepts.title: passport.updated
concepts.description: Passport edited in place
